rfis: Data room re-submission: zero facts were extracted. Provide a complete machine-readable data room index and re-upload all files (text-layer PDFs, native model spreadsheets). This gates all other diligence.

Site control: executed leases/options/easements or purchase agreements for all parcels; ALTA title commitment with Schedule B; legal descriptions and APNs; total controlled acreage (currently null); term covering PPA tenor plus extensions; mineral rights; Williamson Act contract status per parcel.

Zoning: Ventura County zoning and General Plan designations per parcel; written zoning verification from Ventura County RMA Planning Division; SOAR voter-approval applicability; discretionary pathway (Conditional Use Permit vs ministerial) under the Non-Coastal Zoning Ordinance.
Permitting matrix: all discretionary and ministerial permits with agency, status, and issuance dates; CEQA lead-agency determination and IS/MND/EIR status; any federal nexus triggering NEPA.

Environmental: protocol biological surveys and CNDDB search; jurisdictional delineation; cultural resources study and CHRIS search; AB 52 consultation record; special-status species list (gnatcatcher, least Bell's vireo, condor, arroyo toad, steelhead if Santa Clara River watershed) and seasonal windows.

Interconnection: CAISO queue number and cluster; Phase I/II study results; point of interconnection and voltage; deliverability (TPD) status; network upgrade cost estimates; Interconnection Agreement status; FERC Order 2023 site-control and deposit evidence; SCE WDAT or CPUC Rule 21 status if distribution-connected.

Offtake: executed PPA/LOI/term sheets; buyer identity and credit; price, tenor, escalation, contracted MW/MWh; resource adequacy allocation; contracted-vs-merchant split and merchant assumptions (CAISO SP15).
Yield: P50/P90 report with irradiance source (e.g., NREL NSRDB), losses, curtailment, degradation; DC/AC ratio; battery MW/MWh, round-trip efficiency, augmentation and dispatch assumptions.

CAPEX/EPC: EPC contract or term sheet with $/Wac and cost breakdown; supply agreements or quotes for modules, trackers, inverters, BESS, GSU/main transformers; order and delivery dates; LDs, warranties, bonding.
Schedule: integrated milestones (COD, NTP, permit issuance, equipment order/delivery) with float analysis; confirmation no early site work precedes environmental clearance.

Tax: ITC vs PTC election (Sections 48E/45Y); beginning-of-construction strategy and evidence; OBBBA compliance plan (BOC by July 4, 2026 or placed-in-service by December 31, 2027); FEOC material assistance cost ratio analysis; domestic content and energy community adders; transferability plan.
Financing: debt sizing and term sheet; DSCR covenants; contingency/escalation reserves (flag anything below 10-15 percent); equity commitments; sources and uses; downside sensitivities.
Water/stormwater: construction and operations water budget and source; dust control plan; CGP enrollment and SWPPP status; Ventura County MS4 compliance approach.
BESS safety: UL 9540 listing and UL 9540A test data; NFPA 855 and California Fire Code Section 1207 design; draft emergency response plan; Hazardous Materials Business Plan for CUPA.
Community: community benefits agreement or draft; local hire commitments; opposition-risk assessment including Farm Bureau of Ventura County and SOAR advocates; local tax/lease revenue context.
Physical: geotechnical report; ALTA survey; Alquist-Priolo/fault-rupture evaluation (Oak Ridge, Ventura, San Cayetano faults); floodplain study; glare analysis if near Camarillo or Oxnard airports.

agency_actions.agency: Ventura County Resource Management Agency, Planning Division
agency_actions.action: Request written zoning verification for all APNs and hold a pre-application meeting to confirm the CUP pathway under the Non-Coastal Zoning Ordinance, General Plan consistency, and SOAR voter-approval applicability.
agency_actions.why: Zoning is an unresolved kill criterion; a threshold prohibition or SOAR trigger cannot be excluded without county confirmation, and the CUP path drives the CEQA timeline.
agency_actions.deadline: Verification request within 10 business days; pre-app within 30 days.

agency_actions.agency: Ventura County RMA Planning Division (CEQA lead agency)
agency_actions.action: Confirm CEQA lead-agency status and initiate the Initial Study to determine MND vs EIR.
agency_actions.why: CEQA is the schedule-critical path; EIR-level review runs 12-18 months and gates the CUP hearing and construction start.
agency_actions.deadline: File CUP/CEQA application within 60 days of zoning confirmation.

agency_actions.agency: California Department of Conservation, Division of Land Resource Protection, with Ventura County Agricultural Commissioner
agency_actions.action: Obtain Williamson Act contract status and FMMP farmland designations for all parcels; if contracted, pursue compatibility determination, nonrenewal, or cancellation analysis.
agency_actions.why: An active Williamson Act contract can prohibit non-agricultural use and act as a kill-switch alongside SOAR.
agency_actions.deadline: Within 30 days.

agency_actions.agency: California Independent System Operator (CAISO)
agency_actions.action: Verify queue position and cluster, obtain Phase I/II study results and network upgrade cost allocation, confirm Transmission Plan Deliverability status, and calendar FERC Order 2023 site-control and deposit milestones.
agency_actions.why: Deliverability and upgrade cost exposure are untestable without study results; Order 2023 gating can forfeit the queue position if site control is deficient.
agency_actions.deadline: Within 30 days; calendar all cluster deadlines immediately.

agency_actions.agency: Southern California Edison (Participating Transmission Owner)
agency_actions.action: Open interconnection facilities scoping for the point of interconnection and gen-tie; confirm WDAT vs CPUC Rule 21 if any distribution connection.
agency_actions.why: SCE builds interconnection facilities and upgrades on the CAISO grid in Ventura County; scope and lead time drive cost and the delivery-to-COD float.
agency_actions.deadline: Within 45 days, aligned to the CAISO cluster schedule.

agency_actions.agency: California Public Utilities Commission
agency_actions.action: Obtain a General Order 131-D determination for the gen-tie: Permit to Construct (50-200 kV), CPCN (200 kV+), or exemption.
agency_actions.why: A CPCN adds 12-18 months with CPUC-led CEQA review; must be resolved before the schedule is credible.
agency_actions.deadline: Within 60 days of point-of-interconnection confirmation.

agency_actions.agency: California State Water Resources Control Board
agency_actions.action: Prepare Construction General Permit (Order 2022-0057-DWQ) enrollment via SMARTS with risk-level calculation and draft SWPPP.
agency_actions.why: CGP coverage is mandatory before ground disturbance; late enrollment is a common avoidable NTP delay.
agency_actions.deadline: File Permit Registration Documents at least 30 days before ground disturbance.

agency_actions.agency: Los Angeles Regional Water Quality Control Board (Region 4)
agency_actions.action: Confirm Section 401 certification needs if a federal nexus exists, and post-construction stormwater compliance under the regional Phase I MS4 permit covering Ventura County.
agency_actions.why: 401 timing must sequence with the USACE 404 permit; MS4 low-impact-development rules affect site design and drainage cost.
agency_actions.deadline: Within 90 days, or immediately upon federal nexus confirmation.

agency_actions.agency: California Department of Fish and Wildlife, South Coast Region (Region 5)
agency_actions.action: Pre-application consultation; determine need for a Lake and Streambed Alteration Agreement (Section 1602) and any CESA Section 2081 incidental take permit.
agency_actions.why: 1602/2081 authorizations are schedule-gating and define seasonal construction windows.
agency_actions.deadline: Initiate within 60 days; protocol surveys in the next applicable season.

agency_actions.agency: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Ventura Fish and Wildlife Office
agency_actions.action: Obtain official species list (IPaC) and technical assistance; scope Section 7 consultation if a federal nexus exists (gnatcatcher, vireo, flycatcher, arroyo toad, stickleback, condor).
agency_actions.why: Ventura County is within condor range and the Santa Clara River watershed; ESA findings drive survey seasons, buffers, and HCP need if no federal nexus.
agency_actions.deadline: Species list within 2 weeks; survey plan before next spring season.

agency_actions.agency: NOAA Fisheries, West Coast Region
agency_actions.action: If work affects the Santa Clara River, Sespe, Piru, or Ventura River, confirm Southern California steelhead critical habitat consultation requirements.
agency_actions.why: Steelhead critical habitat can impose in-water work windows and crossing-design constraints on gen-tie or access routes.
agency_actions.deadline: Within 90 days, contingent on the jurisdictional delineation.

agency_actions.agency: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Los Angeles District
agency_actions.action: Submit aquatic resources delineation for an approved jurisdictional determination; identify nationwide vs individual Section 404 permit.
agency_actions.why: An approved JD fixes the federal nexus, 401/ESA scope, and mitigation costs; an individual permit adds 12-plus months.
agency_actions.deadline: Submit within 90 days of completing field work.

agency_actions.agency: California Native American Heritage Commission
agency_actions.action: Request Sacred Lands File search and tribal contact list; support Ventura County AB 52 consultation (e.g., Barbareno/Ventureno Band of Mission Indians, Santa Ynez Band of Chumash).
agency_actions.why: AB 52 consultation is a CEQA prerequisite; tribal cultural findings can force redesign.
agency_actions.deadline: SLF request within 10 business days; AB 52 notices within 14 days of CEQA filing.

agency_actions.agency: California Office of Historic Preservation (SHPO) / South Central Coastal Information Center
agency_actions.action: Order CHRIS records search; initiate Section 106 consultation with SHPO if a federal nexus exists.
agency_actions.why: Section 106 concurrence is required before any federal permit issues; late cultural discoveries stop construction.
agency_actions.deadline: Records search within 30 days; Section 106 upon nexus confirmation.

agency_actions.agency: Ventura County Air Pollution Control District
agency_actions.action: Confirm Rule 55 fugitive dust control plan requirements and any stationary source permits (backup generators).
agency_actions.why: Dust plan approval is a grading-permit precondition and affects the construction water budget.
agency_actions.deadline: Before grading permit application.

agency_actions.agency: Ventura County Fire Protection District
agency_actions.action: BESS design review under California Fire Code Section 1207 and NFPA 855, including UL 9540A evaluation, access, defensible space, and emergency response plan.
agency_actions.why: Fire marshal approval gates BESS building permits; scrutiny has increased after recent BESS fire events.
agency_actions.deadline: Design review before building permit submittal; ERP before commissioning.

agency_actions.agency: Ventura County Environmental Health Division (CUPA)
agency_actions.action: Confirm Hazardous Materials Business Plan thresholds for BESS electrolyte and chemicals and the filing timeline.
agency_actions.why: HMBP filing is a legal precondition to operating the storage system.
agency_actions.deadline: File within 30 days of hazardous materials on site.

agency_actions.agency: Ventura County Public Works Agency
agency_actions.action: Scope grading, encroachment, and oversize-load transport permits, including transformer delivery routes and floodplain encroachment review.
agency_actions.why: GSU transformers at 128-144 week lead times arrive as oversize loads; route constraints must be solved before delivery commitments are credible.
agency_actions.deadline: Route study within 90 days of equipment order.

agency_actions.agency: California Energy Commission
agency_actions.action: Evaluate the AB 205 Opt-In Certification program as an alternative consolidated permitting pathway with CEC as CEQA lead agency.
agency_actions.why: Opt-in certification can compress timelines and preempt local discretionary risk given the unresolved zoning kill criterion and SOAR exposure.
agency_actions.deadline: Pathway decision within 60 days, before filing the county CUP application.

agency_actions.agency: Internal Revenue Service / U.S. Department of the Treasury
agency_actions.action: Document beginning-of-construction (physical work test or 5 percent safe harbor per Notices 2013-29 and 2018-59 as applied to Sections 48E/45Y) and build the OBBBA compliance file with FEOC material assistance cost ratio tracking.
agency_actions.why: Tax credit eligibility is an unresolved kill criterion: missing the July 4, 2026 BOC date forces placed-in-service by December 31, 2027; FEOC violations can claw back the entire credit.
agency_actions.deadline: BOC evidence package before July 4, 2026; FEOC supplier certifications at equipment order.

verification_requests: Offtake: confirm directly with the named buyer (or parent guarantor) the existence, execution status, price, tenor, and contracted MW/MWh of any PPA/LOI/term sheet; pull buyer credit rating; if merchant, obtain CAISO SP15 forward curves and two independent price forecasts.

Interconnection: verify queue position, study results, deliverability, and upgrade cost allocation against CAISO public queue data and written CAISO confirmation; confirm interconnection facilities scope and cost with Southern California Edison.

Long-lead equipment: obtain written delivery commitments from GSU/main transformer manufacturers; verify quoted lead times against the 128-144 week market norm; confirm order dates, payment milestones, and factory slots; same for BESS integrator and module suppliers.
EPC/CAPEX: verify EPC price and scope with the contractor; benchmark $/Wac against LBNL Utility-Scale Solar and NREL ATB (approximately $1.43-1.56/Wac) and reconcile variances in writing.
Yield: commission an independent energy assessment (P50/P90, irradiance source, losses, degradation, battery dispatch) and reconcile against the developer model and regional analogs.
Title: obtain an ALTA title commitment from a national title insurer; verify the insured footprint matches the layout; confirm lease execution and term with each landowner of record.

Tax: obtain a written opinion from project-finance tax counsel on ITC/PTC election, BOC facts, OBBBA deadline compliance, and FEOC analysis; verify supplier FEOC certifications directly with manufacturers.
Financing: verify debt term sheet and DSCR covenants with the lead arranger; verify equity commitments with named sponsors; test reserves against the 10-15 percent prudent escalation range.
Community: verify any claimed community benefits agreement or local support directly with named organizations and the Farm Bureau of Ventura County; confirm SOAR ballot-measure risk.
conditions_precedent: Extraction re-run: document acquisition and extraction re-run producing a non-empty fact base; no IC vote on a dossier with zero extracted facts.

Zoning kill criterion resolved: written Ventura County zoning verification confirming a lawful permit pathway, no threshold prohibition, and no unresolved SOAR voter-approval trigger; or an accepted CEC AB 205 opt-in strategy.

Tax kill criterion resolved: tax counsel opinion confirming Section 48E/45Y eligibility, a documented beginning-of-construction plan meeting the OBBBA cliff (BOC by July 4, 2026 or COD by December 31, 2027), and a FEOC-compliant supply chain.
Site control verified: executed agreements covering 100 percent of the project footprint with term sufficient for the PPA tenor, confirmed by ALTA title commitment; Williamson Act conflicts resolved.

Interconnection verified: CAISO queue position, cluster study results, deliverability status, and network upgrade cost cap confirmed; Order 2023 site-control and deposit milestones current; upgrade cost exposure reflected in the model.

Revenue verified: executed PPA (or bankable term sheet with credit support) confirming price, tenor, and contracted volume; merchant share supported by independent forecasts; revenue within market $/MWh comparables.

CAPEX and schedule validated: EPC price benchmarked against $1.43-1.56/Wac; equipment lead times verified in writing (transformers 128-144 weeks); schedule showing at least 6 months delivery-to-COD float and no construction before environmental clearance.

Environmental path defined: CEQA document underway with lead agency confirmed; protocol surveys completed or scheduled in-season; 1602/404/401/ESA needs scoped; AB 52 consultation initiated; no unmitigated schedule-gating survey season.

Financing committed: debt term sheet with DSCR covenants and equity commitments verified; contingency and escalation reserves at prudent levels (10-15 percent); model passes P90 and merchant-downside sensitivities.
BESS safety accepted: UL 9540A data reviewed, NFPA 855/CFC 1207 design accepted by Ventura County Fire Protection District, and emergency response plan in place before NTP.

recommended_next_action: Empty dossier: zero facts, findings, or acquired documents were extracted — cross-examination is impossible by construction and no dimension can be verified; re-run document acquisition/extraction before any further scoring
